# Bharat eFiling

> Bharat eFiling (bharatefiling.com) is an Indian online platform for CA-assisted income-tax return filing, GST registration and returns, business registration, trademark and compliance services for individuals, startups and MSMEs.

Pages are reviewed by Chartered Accountants and updated for the CGST Act, 2017, the CGST Rules, 2017 and the Income-tax Act, 2025 (in force from 1 April 2026).

## GST services
- [GST Registration](https://bharatefiling.com/gst-registration/): eligibility, turnover limits, Rule 14A 3-day registration, documents, process, fees, penalties and FAQs
- [GST LUT Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/gst-lut-filing/): Letter of Undertaking in Form GST RFD-11, eligibility, validity, Rule 96A export deadlines, documents, process, refunds and FAQs
- [GST Return Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/gst-return-filing/): GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9 filing
- [GST Registration Amendment](https://bharatefiling.com/gst-registration-amendment/): core vs non-core fields, Form REG-14, 15-day time limit, documents, when a new GSTIN is needed and FAQs
- [GST Revocation](https://bharatefiling.com/gst-revocation/): revocation of cancelled GST registration in Form REG-21, 90-day limit and 180-day extension, pending returns, REG-23/REG-24, options after the deadline and FAQs
- [GSTR-10 Final Return Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/gstr-10-filing/): final return after GST cancellation, 3-month due date, ₹200/day late fee up to ₹10,000, closing stock reversal under Section 29(5), GSTR-3A notices and FAQs
- [GST Annual Return Filing (GSTR-9)](https://bharatefiling.com/gst-annual-return-filing/): GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C applicability by turnover, FY 2025-26 due date, late fee, missed-ITC deadline, tables, documents and FAQs
- [GST Notice Reply](https://bharatefiling.com/gst-notice-reply/): types of GST notices (ASMT-10, DRC-01, DRC-01B/01C, GSTR-3A, REG-17), reply forms and deadlines, Section 74A penalty relief, appeals and FAQs
- [GST LUT Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/gst-lut-filing/): export without paying IGST

## Income tax
- [ITR Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/income-tax-return-filing/)
- [Income Tax e-Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/income-tax-e-filing/): how to e-file an ITR for FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27), who must file, which ITR form, due dates, belated, revised and updated returns, e-verification, refunds and FAQs
- [Business ITR Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/business-itr-filing/): ITR-3, ITR-4, ITR-5 and ITR-6 for proprietors, firms, LLPs and companies; presumptive taxation (44AD, 44ADA, 44AE), tax audit, partner remuneration and Section 194T TDS, due dates for FY 2025-26 and FAQs
- [Partnership Firm & LLP ITR Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/partnership-llp-itr-filing/): ITR-5 for partnership firms and LLPs, 30% tax rate, partner remuneration under Section 40(b), Section 194T TDS, tax and LLP audits, LLP Form 8 and Form 11, due dates for FY 2025-26 and FAQs
- [Company ITR Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/company-itr-filing/): ITR-6 for companies, Section 115BAA vs normal tax and MAT, Form 10-IC, losses and Section 79, Section 80-IAC startups, ROC filings AOC-4 and MGT-7, due dates for FY 2025-26 and FAQs
- [Trust & NGO Tax Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/trust-ngo-itr-filing/): ITR-7 for trusts, societies and Section 8 companies; 85% application, Form 10 and 9A, Form 10B/10BB audit, corpus and anonymous donations, 80G Form 10BD/10BE, 12AB renewal, FCRA FC-4, due dates for FY 2025-26 and FAQs
- [TAN Registration](https://bharatefiling.com/tan-registration/): applying for TAN in Form 49B, who needs a TAN and the PAN-based exceptions (26QB, 26QC, 26QD), TDS deposit and quarterly return dates, penalties and FAQs
- [TDS Return Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/tds-return-filing/): quarterly TDS and TCS returns (24Q, 26Q, 27Q, 27EQ), due dates, Form 16 and 16A, Section 234E late fee and 271H penalty, TRACES defaults and corrections, TDS rates and thresholds from April 2025, and FAQs
- [Income Tax Notice Reply](https://bharatefiling.com/income-tax-notice/): what income tax notices under Sections 139(9), 143(1)(a), 143(2), 142(1), 148A, 156, 245 and 270A mean, reply deadlines, DIN verification, demand interest, penalties, rectification and appeals, and FAQs
- [Revised & Updated Return (ITR-U)](https://bharatefiling.com/updated-return-itr-u/): revised returns under Section 139(5) and updated returns under Section 139(8A), the 48-month window, 25% to 70% additional tax, when ITR-U is barred, other routes, and FAQs
- [Income-tax Act, 2025 changes](https://bharatefiling.com/learn/income-tax-act-2025-changes/)

## Compliance
- [Company Compliance](https://bharatefiling.com/company-compliance/): annual ROC compliance for private limited companies and OPCs: board meetings, AGM, AOC-4, MGT-7/7A, ADT-1, DPT-3, MSME-1, DIR-3 KYC (every three years from 2026), small company limits, late fees and FAQs
- [LLP Compliance](https://bharatefiling.com/llp-compliance/): annual LLP compliance: Form 11 by 30 May, Form 8 by 30 October, ITR-5, audit thresholds, Form 3 and Form 4 for partner changes, DIR-3 KYC for designated partners, ₹100 a day late fees and FAQs
- [OPC Compliance](https://bharatefiling.com/opc-compliance/): annual compliance for One Person Companies: no AGM, AOC-4 within 180 days, MGT-7A, audit, board meeting relief, nominee changes (INC-3, INC-4), conversion (INC-6), ITR-6, late fees and FAQs
- [Company Name Change](https://bharatefiling.com/company-name-change/): changing the name of a private limited company, OPC or LLP: name rules, RUN, special resolution, MGT-14, INC-24 and INC-25, LLP Form 5 and Form 3, Rule 29 bar, former name for two years, PAN, TAN and GST updates and FAQs
- [Registered Office Change](https://bharatefiling.com/registered-office-change/): shifting the registered office of a company, OPC or LLP: same city (board resolution, INC-22), same state (special resolution, MGT-14), another ROC or state (INC-23, INC-26, INC-28), LLP Form 15, GST and PAN updates, penalties and FAQs
- [DIN eKYC Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/din-ekyc-filing/): DIR-3 KYC Web for DIN holders under the three-year cycle from 31 March 2026 (due by 30 June), 30-day updates for mobile, email or address, DIR-6, deactivated DIN reactivation with the ₹5,000 late fee and FAQs
- [DIN Reactivation](https://bharatefiling.com/din-reactivation/): reactivating a DIN deactivated for missed DIR-3 KYC (DIR-3 KYC Web with the flat ₹5,000 late fee), DIN statuses, Section 164(2) disqualification and its five-year period, surrendered DINs, PAN and DSC checks and FAQs
- [Director Change](https://bharatefiling.com/director-change/): appointment, resignation and removal of company directors: DIR-2, DIR-8, additional directors (Section 161), resignation (Section 168, DIR-11), removal by special notice (Section 169), DIR-12 within 30 days, minimum and resident directors, LLP Form 4, GST and bank updates and FAQs
- [Remove a Director](https://bharatefiling.com/remove-director/): removing a company director under Section 169 (special notice under Section 115 and Rule 23, right to be heard, ordinary resolution, DIR-12), EGM requisition under Section 100, automatic vacation under Section 167, removing your own name with DIR-11, and FAQs
- [ADT-1 Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/adt-1-filing/): filing ADT-1 within 15 days of appointing a company auditor: first auditor (Section 139(6)), five-year appointment at the AGM, casual vacancy, consent and Section 141 certificate, rotation rules, ADT-2 and ADT-3, and FAQs
- [DPT-3 Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/dpt-3-filing/): annual return of deposits and exempted receipts by 30 June (figures as on 31 March): loans from directors, relatives and companies, declarations, customer advances (365 days), share application money (60 + 15 days), member deposits, the ₹20,000 cash rule and FAQs
- [LLP Form 11 Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/llp-form-11-filing/): LLP annual return due by 30 May: contents, designated partner signature and CS certification (contribution over ₹50 lakh or turnover over ₹5 crore), ₹100 a day late fee, catch-up of pending years, Form 4 and Form 8 links, and FAQs
- [Dormant Status Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/dormant-status-filing/): dormant company status under Section 455: who qualifies (inactive two years, future project, asset holding), blockers, special resolution, MSC-1 and MSC-2, yearly MSC-3 by 30 April, board meetings, five-year limit, MSC-4 reactivation and FAQs
- [MOA Amendment](https://bharatefiling.com/moa-amendment/): altering a company memorandum: objects clause by special resolution and MGT-14, authorised capital increase by ordinary resolution and SH-7 (Sections 61 and 64), other clauses, new-format MOA, registration within 30 days, and FAQs
- [AOA Amendment](https://bharatefiling.com/aoa-amendment/): altering the articles of association under Section 14: special resolution and MGT-14 within 30 days, new Table F articles, investor rights from shareholders agreements, entrenchment (Section 5), private-public conversion (INC-27), and FAQs
- [Authorised Capital Increase](https://bharatefiling.com/authorised-capital-increase/): increasing authorised share capital under Section 61 by ordinary resolution (articles permitting) and SH-7 within 30 days, sizing the new limit, share split and consolidation, follow-on allotment with PAS-3 in 15 days, and FAQs
- [Share Transfer](https://bharatefiling.com/share-transfer/): transferring shares in a private company: SH-4 lodged within 60 days, articles and ROFR, board approval, certificate within one month, refusal and appeal, Rule 9B demat, BEN-2 and FC-TRS, transmission, capital gains on unlisted shares, and FAQs
- [Demat of Shares](https://bharatefiling.com/demat-of-shares/): dematerialising company shares under Rules 9A and 9B: who is covered (private companies other than small companies, unlisted public companies), the 30 June 2025 and 18-month deadlines, ISIN with NSDL and CDSL, shareholder demat requests, half-yearly PAS-6, and FAQs
- [LLP Winding Up](https://bharatefiling.com/llp-winding-up/): closing an LLP: strike off in Form 24 under Section 75 and Rule 37 (no business for a year, nil assets and liabilities, partners' consent), catching up pending Form 8 and Form 11, voluntary liquidation of solvent LLPs under IBC Section 59, winding up by the Tribunal, GST and tax closure, restoration, and FAQs
- [Company Winding Up](https://bharatefiling.com/company-winding-up/): closing a private company or OPC: strike off in STK-2 under Section 248(2) (no business for two financial years, liabilities extinguished, special resolution or 75% consent), STK-8, STK-3 and STK-4, C-PACE processing, catching up pending AOC-4 and MGT-7, voluntary liquidation under IBC Section 59, winding up by the Tribunal under Section 271, restoration under Section 252, and FAQs
- [INC-20A Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/inc-20a-filing/): the declaration for commencement of business under Section 10A: who files (companies with share capital incorporated on or after 2 November 2018), the 180-day deadline, proof of subscription money, certification, penalties (₹50,000 on the company, ₹1,000 a day per officer up to ₹1 lakh, Section 446B relief), strike-off risk, other early deadlines, and FAQs
- [CA Consultation](https://bharatefiling.com/ca-consultation/): one-to-one phone or video consultations with practising chartered accountants on income tax, capital gains, advance tax, GST, business set-up, tax notices and NRI taxation, with a written summary; covers the Income-tax Act, 2025 (tax year 2026-27), advance tax instalments, ICAI verification and confidentiality, and FAQs
- [Legal Consultation](https://bharatefiling.com/legal-consultation/): one-to-one phone or video consultations with independent advocates on contracts, legal notices, cheque bounce (Sections 138 and 142 of the Negotiable Instruments Act), consumer complaints (Consumer Protection Act, 2019 forums and two-year limitation), recovery, property, employment and startup matters, with a written note; general information, not legal advice; and FAQs
- [Digital Signature](https://bharatefiling.com/digital-signature/): Class 3 digital signature certificates (the only class issued since 1 January 2021) under the Information Technology Act, 2000: signature, encryption and combo types, individual and organisation certificates, CCA identity verification (Aadhaar eKYC, video), USB tokens, use on MCA, income tax (companies) and GST (companies, CGST Rule 26), validity and renewal, and FAQs
- [ICEGATE Registration](https://bharatefiling.com/icegate-registration/): registration on ICEGATE, the CBIC customs portal, for importers, exporters and customs brokers: IEC, PAN, DGFT-matched contact details and Class 3 DSC, bank account and AD code registration, the IGST export refund chain (shipping bill under CGST Rule 96, EGM, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, PFMS validation), annual IEC update, LUT, and FAQs
- [Import Export Code](https://bharatefiling.com/import-export-code/): IEC registration with DGFT under Section 7 of the Foreign Trade (Development and Regulation) Act, 1992: who needs it, PAN-based 10-character code, documents (PAN, address proof, bank proof), DSC or Aadhaar e-sign, annual update between 1 April and 30 June and deactivation, modifications, personal-use exemption, next steps (ICEGATE, LUT), and FAQs
- [Legal Name Change](https://bharatefiling.com/legal-name-change/): changing an individual's name in India: affidavit, two newspaper advertisements, Gazette of India (Department of Publication) or State Gazette publication, routes for marriage, divorce, spelling corrections and minors, updating Aadhaar (two name updates in a lifetime, UIDAI), PAN and passport (Gazette accepted by Passport Seva), and FAQs
- [Udyam Registration](https://bharatefiling.com/msme-udyam-registration/): MSME registration on Udyam: limits from 1 April 2025 (S.O. 1364(E): micro ₹2.5 cr investment and ₹10 cr turnover, small ₹25 cr and ₹100 cr, medium ₹125 cr and ₹500 cr, exports excluded), Aadhaar, PAN and GSTIN, traders, the 45-day payment rule (MSMED Act Sections 15 and 16, MSME Samadhaan), MSME Form 1, section 43B(h) and section 37(2)(g) of the Income-tax Act, 2025, and FAQs
- [Shop Act Registration](https://bharatefiling.com/shop-act-registration/): registration of shops, offices and commercial establishments under state Shops and Establishments Acts, the Labour Codes in force from 21 November 2025 and OSH Code registration for 10 or more workers, Maharashtra's 2017 Act (Form A registration, Form F intimation, 60 days), documents, and FAQs
- [Proprietorship](https://bharatefiling.com/proprietorship-registration/): starting a sole proprietorship in India: no single registration law, the proprietor's PAN, GST thresholds (₹40 lakh goods, ₹20 lakh services in most states), Udyam and Shop Act, two proofs of business for a current account under RBI KYC rules, presumptive taxation under section 58 and tax audit under section 63 of the Income-tax Act, 2025, advance tax, and FAQs
